Farmers add calcium oxide (lime) and ammonium salts to their fields.
The compounds are not added at the same time because they react with each other.
Which gas is produced in this reaction?
A
ammonia
B
carbon dioxide
C
hydrogen
D
nitrogen
subject: Chemistry
